response.rationale: “Tahun lalu” is the ordinary Indonesian expression, while “tahun lepas” is the ordinary Malaysian Malay preference for the same immediately preceding calendar year. The contrast is useful without implying exclusivity.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Tahun sebelumnya” is understandable and usable in both varieties, especially in more formal contexts, but it does not undermine the useful everyday preference for “tahun lalu” in Indonesian and “tahun lepas” in Malaysian Malay.
